info.title: Attome XRM API
info.description: The Attome XRM platform's HTTP API. Entity record shapes under `/api/v1/{entity}` are resolved from each deployment's runtime metadata (D-003) and therefore cannot be enumerated statically — those operations document the generic envelope only. Fetch `GET /api/v1/schema/{logicalname}` for a live entity's fields.

get.description:
The pages of one space that are not deleted: the root pages, or the children of one page, or the
pages whose name contains the search text anywhere in the tree; one-based pages. Content
administrators only.

parameters.name: content_space_id
parameters.description:
Every list is scoped to one space — pages in other spaces never
appear, matching the admin UI's per-space "Pages" screen.

parameters.name: parent_page_id
parameters.description:
Children of this page. Omit for root-level pages. Ignored when
`search` is set (search runs across the whole tree).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: One-based: page 1 is the first page.

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

post.description:
A draft page in a space, under a parent page or at the root, with its title and URL path,
optionally from a template. Content administrators only. Audited.

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

409.description: url_path is already in use by another live page

422.description: Request failed validation

get.description:
One page: its draft and published blocks, SEO fields, status, publishing schedule and
`row_version`. Content administrators only.

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

delete.description: Marks the page deleted. Content administrators only. Audited.

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

patch.description:
Changes the title, URL path, blocks or SEO fields given. Requires `If-Match: "<row_version>"`;
a missing or stale one is refused. Content administrators only. Audited.

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

409.description: If-Match's row_version is stale, or url_path is already in use by another live page

422.description: Request failed validation, or If-Match is missing/malformed

get.description: The pages above this one, furthest first, for a breadcrumb. Content administrators only.

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

put.summary: Makes a page a knowledge article, or an ordinary page again (G11-T1).
put.description:
An article names the knowledge data source it is filed under, a category
and products; while published it is searchable as a knowledge item
written as the caller, who needs to be able to create knowledge items.
`knowledge_source_id: null` makes it an ordinary page and withdraws it
from search.

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, may not create knowledge items, or Content Management is not licensed

422.description: A bad category or product, or a knowledge source the caller cannot see

get.summary: A CMS page as a page document.
get.description:
The page's draft blocks mapped onto the page palette (T2-T4), with its
title and SEO title and description, for the page designer to open.

200.description: The page document the page designer opens

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

422.description: An audience other than public, portal or internal

put.summary: Sets who may read a page (K5-T2).
put.description:
`public`: anyone, through the public view and delivery routes.
`internal`: signed-in people only; the public routes answer it with the
same 404 as a missing page.

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

422.description: The audience is not public or internal

post.description:
Puts the page under another parent, or at the root; a move under the page itself or one of its
descendants is refused. Content administrators only. Audited.

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

409.description: A hierarchy change is already in progress, or this move would create a cycle

post.summary: A signed link to a page's current draft (K5-T2).
post.description:
Anyone with the link reads the draft until it expires (60 minutes unless
`minutes` says otherwise, at most seven days); it opens nothing else.

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

422.description: minutes is out of range

post.summary: Publishes a page's draft (K5-T1: as a new numbered version).
post.description:
The draft's blocks are checked again and become the published content; the
publish is kept as the page's next version. In a space that requires
approval the publish waits for it instead (202 with the request's id).

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

422.description: The current draft fails block validation

get.description: The pages linked to this one as related that are not deleted. Content administrators only.

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

put.description:
Replaces the page's related pages with the ones given; each link works both ways. A page cannot be
related to itself. Content administrators only. Audited.

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

422.description: related_page_ids includes this page itself, or a page that does not exist

patch.description:
Sets the date the page should be reviewed by, or clears it with `null`; a reminder goes out when it
comes. Requires `If-Match`. Content administrators only. Audited.

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

422.description: If-Match is missing/malformed

put.description:
Sets or clears (`null`) when the page is published and unpublished; a background sweep changes
its status when the time passes. Requires `If-Match`. Content administrators only. Audited.

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

422.description: unpublish_at is not after publish_at, or If-Match is missing/malformed

get.description:
E13-T8: the title, description, canonical URL, robots flags and Open
Graph card stored on the page, with its row version.

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege

put.description:
E13-T8: replaces the settings at the `If-Match` row version. A change to
the canonical URL or the noindex flag is recorded as a configuration
event in the same transaction.

200.description: The saved settings and the new row version

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege

409.description: The page changed since that row version

422.description: If-Match missing or malformed, or a setting out of bounds

post.description:
E13-T8: runs the page audit at once (whether or not audits run on save)
and replaces the stored findings and score.

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege

x-audit-exempt.note: recomputes the page's derived search findings and score; changes no content or setting

get.description: E13-T8: the findings of the page's last audit, errors first.

Views, retrievals by search and AI, helpful and unhelpful votes and when it was last useful, as

post.summary: Marks a translation up to date with its source (K5-T4).
post.description:
Records the source's latest published version against the translation,
so it is no longer stale until the source is published again. Asked of a
page that is not a translation, it answers 404.

200.description: The translation is up to date

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

get.summary: A page's translations and whether each is stale (K5-T4).
get.description:
Asked of a source page or of any of its translations, it answers the
source and every translation of it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A source page's id, or a translation's

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

post.summary: Creates a linked translation of a page (K5-T4).
post.description:
The new page sits beside its source (same space and parent) with the
source's published blocks as its draft, ready to translate; it starts up to
date with the source's latest version. A translation cannot itself be
translated: translate its source.

409.description: The url_path is taken, or the page already has a translation into this language

422.description: Bad language, title or url_path, or the page is itself a translation

get.description: The title, SEO text and blocks exactly as that version was published.

post.summary: Restores an old version of a page (K5-T1).
post.description:
The version's title, SEO text and blocks become the page's draft and are
published as a new version that names the restored one. In a space that
requires approval the restored draft waits for approval (202 with the
request's id) like any other publish.

200.description: Restored and published as a new version

202.description: Restored to the draft; the publish waits for approval

403.description: Caller lacks the required privilege, or Content Management is not licensed

422.description: The restored blocks fail today's block validation

depth.description: Distance from the queried page — 1 is its immediate parent.

knowledge_source_id.description:
The knowledge data source to file the article under; `null` makes the
page an ordinary page again.

knowledge_item_id.description: The knowledge item the article is projected into, once it has been.

Block.description:
One block on the canvas. `props` is validated against `kind`'s shape by
`blocks::validate_blocks` before a draft save or publish is accepted —
never stored as trusted-opaque JSON (coding-guidelines §8).

BlockChange.description: What happened to one block between two versions, by block `id`.

from_index.description: Its position in the older version, if it was there.

to_index.description: Its position in the newer version, if it is there.

BlockKind.description:
The full block library (mockup's block-library modal). Kept as a real
enum (not a bare string) so an unrecognized `kind` is rejected by
deserialization itself, before `blocks::validate_blocks` ever runs.

ContentSpace.description:
A reusable container of pages — a pure organizational grouping, not a URL
namespace (`url_path` uniqueness stays global across all spaces; see
D-369). Infra-mutable class (D-005).

blog_path.description: Pages under this path are the site's blog posts.

domain.description: E12-T2: the domain this space is served on.

kind.description: E11-T1: `standard` or `marketing` (landing pages), set at create.

require_approval.description: K5-T1: a publish in this space waits for approval.

template_id.description:
When set, must be one of `content_space_id`'s allowed templates
(`content_space_template`) — its `blocks` are copied into the new
page's `blocks_draft` once, at create time.

kind.description:
E11-T1: `standard` (the default) or `marketing`; a marketing space
starts with the landing page templates. Fixed once created.

require_approval.description: K5-T1: a publish in this space waits for approval.

language.description: The translation's language code, e.g. `ar` or `en-GB`.

ErrorDetails.description:
`ErrorResponse.details`: its shape depends on the `error` code —
a list of [`FieldError`] on `validation_error`, [`RuleViolationDetails`] on
`rule_violation`, [`FieldLockedDetails`] on `field_locked` and
`field_locked_required` (D-789).

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope. `error` is a stable machine-readable code; `message` is human-readable and never contains internal detail.

current_state.description:
Present on a version conflict: the server's current row for the
fields the caller touched, as a JSON object. The owning engine filters
sensitive columns out before building it (BTY-16c's precondition), so
this is a deliberate filtered projection — never a raw row dump.

current_version.description:
Present on a version conflict: the `row_version` the server currently
holds, so a caller can re-read and retry instead of guessing what the
winner wrote. Omitted when the conflict is not version-based.

oneOf.description:
Structured detail, shaped by `error` (see [`ErrorDetails`]): every
field-level failure on a `validation_error` response when the raiser
has a field list, so a form can render them all at once; every firing
rule on a `rule_violation` response from a business rule; every
refused field on `field_locked` / `field_locked_required`. Omitted
otherwise.

error.description:
Stable machine-readable code — `not_found`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`,
`attribute_not_writable`, `limit_exceeded`,
`conflict`, `version_conflict`, `duplicate_detected`, `idempotency_conflict`,
`validation_error`, `customer_tests_failed`, `feature_unavailable`, `feature_hidden`,
`rate_limit_exceeded`, `overloaded`, `capability_unavailable`,
`metadata_authoring_locked`, `transition_not_allowed`,
`rule_violation`, `field_locked`, `field_locked_required`,
`reauth_required`, `server_timeout`, `query_timeout`, `read_only`, `payload_too_large`,
`request_rejected`, `invalid_cursor`, `resync_needed`, `cascade_restricted`,
`idempotency_outcome_unknown`, `idempotency_replay_unavailable`,
`method_not_allowed`, or
`internal_error` — one per `AppError` variant (`FieldLocked` answers
two: plain and required) (`attome-types/src/error.rs`); M01 Core C-23
found this list four codes short of the taxonomy it documents.

errors.description:
Every field-level failure on a `validation_error`, as
`{attribute, rule, message, fix}`.

field.description:
Present on `field_locked` / `field_locked_required` (D-789): the first
refused field (every one is in `details.fields`); on
`attribute_not_writable` (Q15-T4): the attribute the caller may not
write.

hidden.description:
Present on `duplicate_detected`: how many more matches the caller may
not read.

instance.description: The request path the problem happened at.

matches.description:
Present on `duplicate_detected` (A15-T4): the existing records the
save matches that the caller may read (record, rule, score).

request_id.description:
Present on responses that passed through the request-id middleware
(D-043); absent on the few pre-middleware rejection paths.

retry_after_sec.description:
Present on a `rate_limit_exceeded` response when the limiter knows its
window: seconds to wait before retrying, equal by construction to the
`Retry-After` header on the same response (BTY-11a). Omitted when the
limit that was hit has no known window.

retryable.description:
Whether the same request may succeed later (the error catalogue's
verdict for `code`).

rule_id.description:
Present on a `rule_violation` response (D-472): the id of the
`xrm_core_rule` whose failing expression produced this 422, so a
client can highlight or re-check the exact rule without parsing
`message`. Omitted on every other code, and on any response that
does not name a rule.
Also present on `field_locked` / `field_locked_required` (D-789): the
business rule that locks `field`.

rule_name.description:
Present on `field_locked` / `field_locked_required`: the display name
of the rule that locks `field`.

title.description:
A short title for `code` in the request's language (Z14-T3), e.g.
`The resource was not found.`

type.description: Z14-T1 (RFC 9457): `about:blank`; the problem is named by `code`.

FieldError.description:
One field-level failure inside `ErrorResponse.details` (BTY-16b): the
field the caller sent, a stable machine-readable `code` the client maps
to localized text (e.g. `required`, `too_long`, `invalid_format`,
`not_allowed`), and the English server-side `message`.

A list, not a single error, so one 422 can answer with every bad field at
once (BTY-F11) instead of making a form discover them one round-trip at a
time.

code.description:
Stable machine-readable failure code for this field, independent of
the message text.

field.description:
The offending field, as the caller addressed it (e.g. `email` or
`amount`).

message.description: Human-readable, English, server-side detail for this field.

FieldLockedDetails.description:
`details` of a `field_locked` / `field_locked_required` response: every
refused field, the first being the one the top-level `field` names.

LockedField.description:
One field a business rule locks for the writer (D-789 §3.5): `effect` is
`hidden` or `disabled`. No value is ever echoed.

path.description: A path on the site (`/pricing`) or an absolute http(s) URL.

publish_at.description:
M56 Phase 1 (D-436, migration `0230`) — when set on a `draft` page,
the scheduled-publish sweep publishes it once `NOW()` passes this.

review_by.description:
M37 Phase 2 (D-452) — when set, the owner (`updated_by`) is reminded
through M51 once `NOW()` passes it, and retrieval callers are told the
underlying content is stale. `None` means no review cadence is set,
not "never review".

template_id.description: `None` if this page was built from scratch, not from a template.

unpublish_at.description:
When set on a `published` page, the same sweep reverts it to `draft`
once `NOW()` passes this.

PageSeoView.description: A page's search settings, as the SEO panel reads them.

row_version.description: Send back as `If-Match` on the next `PUT`.

PageStats.description:
The read model `attome_content::analytics::rollup_page_stats` maintains
(D-452). Served by the admin page-stats panel; not written directly by
any request handler.

PaginatedResponse_PageSummary.description: The platform's canonical list envelope (guidelines §12). `total` is the size of the whole set, not of `items`. `page` echoes the page served; every offset list is one-based (D-793): page 1 is the first page. `warnings` is sent only when there is one (Z14-T6).

warnings.description:
Z14-T6: what the caller should know though the list succeeded;
omitted when empty.

PaginatedResponse_PageVersionSummary.description: The platform's canonical list envelope (guidelines §12). `total` is the size of the whole set, not of `items`. `page` echoes the page served; every offset list is one-based (D-793): page 1 is the first page. `warnings` is sent only when there is one (Z14-T6).

items.description: One version in a page's list.

restored_from.description: The version this one restored, if it was a restore.

warnings.description:
Z14-T6: what the caller should know though the list succeeded;
omitted when empty.

PaginatedResponse_SeoFinding.description: The platform's canonical list envelope (guidelines §12). `total` is the size of the whole set, not of `items`. `page` echoes the page served; every offset list is one-based (D-793): page 1 is the first page. `warnings` is sent only when there is one (Z14-T6).

message_key.description: The catalog key of the message.

warnings.description:
Z14-T6: what the caller should know though the list succeeded;
omitted when empty.

PaginatedResponse_SeoTopic.description: The platform's canonical list envelope (guidelines §12). `total` is the size of the whole set, not of `items`. `page` echoes the page served; every offset list is one-based (D-793): page 1 is the first page. `warnings` is sent only when there is one (Z14-T6).

warnings.description:
Z14-T6: what the caller should know though the list succeeded;
omitted when empty.

minutes.description: How long the link works, 1 to 10,080 minutes; 60 when unset.

PublishResult.description:
A publish's outcome: published (with its version), or waiting for
approval in a space that requires it (K5-T1).

approval_request_id.description: The approval request a publish waits for.

RelatedPagesBody.description:
Full-set replace for a page's symmetric "related pages" — the admin API
writes both directions (A→B and B→A) in one transaction, so a read for
either page's related list is a single-direction query.

ReviewByBody.description:
Full replace, `null` clears — same convention as `SchedulePageBody`
(D-452's `review_by`, a plain `Option<NaiveDate>` full-replace, has no
empty-string-vs-null ambiguity to resolve).

RuleFailure.description:
One business-rule `error` policy that fired (D-789 §3.3), inside a
`rule_violation` body's `details.rules`. Carries names and the rule's own
message, never a record value.

field.description: The field the policy is attached to, when it names one.

rule_name.description: The rule's display name (its name when it has none).

RuleViolationDetails.description:
`details` of a `rule_violation` response (D-789): the field of the first
failing policy, when it names one, and every blocking `error` policy that
fired, the first (by rule display order) being the one `rule_id` names.

SchedulePageBody.description:
Full replace, not a partial patch — both fields are always written
exactly as given (`null` clears), so there is no absent-vs-null
ambiguity to resolve (the trap `UpdatePageBody`'s `seo_title`/
`seo_description` sentinel-empty-string convention exists to avoid for a
string field; a plain `Option<DateTime<Utc>>` full-replace is the
simpler fix for a field with no such sentinel).

body.description: The stored body; `null` when the site has none (the default applies).

served.description:
What crawlers are served: the body (or the default) with the paths
that are always closed appended.

SeoTopicBody.description: A topic to create or change.

language.description: `en`, `ar`, or a regional form such as `ar-SA`.

SpaceTemplatesBody.description: Full-set replace for which templates a space's editors may pick from.

source_version.description: The source's latest published version; none when never published.

stale.description: The source has a newer published version than that.

translated_from_version.description: The source version this translation was last brought up to date with.

UpdatePageBody.description:
The optimistic-concurrency guard is the `If-Match` header (D-079's
contract, reused as-is), not a body field — `attome-api`'s
`content_admin::update_page` parses it before this deserializes.

description.description:
`None` leaves the stored value unchanged, `Some("")` clears it,
`Some(nonempty)` sets it — same convention as `UpdatePageBody`'s
`seo_title`/`seo_description`.

Warning.description:
Something the server did that the caller should know about though the
request succeeded (a value truncated, a default applied, a page clamped):
a stable `code` and English `message`. Sent only when there is one.

portal_session.name: __Secure-wp_{portal}_session
portal_session.description: A web portal user's session cookie, issued by the portal's sign-in; `{portal}` is the portal's keyword (`wp_{portal}_session` on plain-http local dev). Valid only on that portal's own routes.

s2s_hmac.name: x-s2s-signature
s2s_hmac.description: A system-to-system call, signed. Send `x-s2s-client-id`, `x-s2s-key-id`, `x-s2s-timestamp` (Unix milliseconds, within 300 seconds of the server's clock), `x-s2s-nonce` (single use: a repeat is refused) and `x-s2s-signature`: the hex HMAC-SHA256, keyed by the hex-decoded client secret, of `METHOD`, `PATH_AND_QUERY`, the hex SHA-256 of the body, `TIMESTAMP` and `NONCE`, joined by newlines in that order.

session_cookie.name: __Host-session_token
session_cookie.description: Browser session cookie issued by POST /api/v1/auth/login. Mutating requests additionally require the CSRF conditions enforced by `middleware::csrf`.
